title.zh: 细分图中的可到达节点

desc.zh: 用最短距离与两端覆盖计数，避开巨大细分图。
desc.en: Count coverage from both ends using shortest distances, without expanding the graph.

complexity: O(n + m log(n + 1)) time; O(n + m) space

concepts.name: Weighted shortest paths
concepts.description: Finalize minimum distances before counting edge coverage.

concepts.name: Capped edge coverage
concepts.description: Count the union of two endpoint prefixes without overlap.
